Job Description



Descripción

¿Te apasiona el análisis de datos y la toma de decisiones estratégicas?



 ¡Entonces este es el lugar para ti! En nuestro equipo, estarás en contacto directo con clientes de grandes marcas de consumo masivo, apoyándolos con recomendaciones basadas en datos e información estratégica. Nuestra área se enfoca en el análisis de paneles de hogares, donde monitoreamos los hábitos de compra de los consumidores y las tendencias del mercado. ¡Serás parte de un equipo que trabaja con datos reales, ayudando a grandes marcas a entender su desempeño y la competencia!



 



Responsabilidades

Como parte del equipo, tu rol será clave para garantizar que nuestros clientes reciban información clara, precisa y útil. Algunas de tus tareas serán:



Soporte Administrativo: Colaborar con el equipo de panel de hogares, subiendo tickets y gestionando el seguimiento de solicitudes con el equipo de operaciones
Análisis de Datos: Extraer y organizar información para crear reportes sencillos y complejos (en Excel y PowerPoint). Aprenderás a realizar análisis detallados que se entregarán a los clientes
Entregables a Clientes: Apoyo en la creación de presentaciones e informes, tanto periódicos como puntuales, con insights clave sobre el comportamiento de los consumidores y las estrategias del mercado
Interacción con el Cliente: Colaboración en la elaboración de entregables que se utilizan para guiar las decisiones de negocio

Estudiantes que se gradúen entre Julio y Septiembre de carreras económicas o afines con interés en análisis de datos y marketing (Marketing, Relaciones Comerciales, Ingeniería Industrial, Matemáticas, Actuaría, etc.)

description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Being part of the Driver Growth Operations team will give you the unique opportunity to help drive growth in one of the fastest growing companies ever. This data driven role calls for a rare combination of user-centric, analytical thinking & interpersonal ability. You will have the opportunity to work in a tight team, where you will launch, build and run DiDi's business in Spanish Speaking LatAm. Be prepared for a hectic, fast paced and challenging environment. Never a dull moment!

Driver Growth Operations team members are very important for the expansion and sustainability of the business. The ideal candidates for our opening roles should have very strong analytical skills (e.g. Python, R, SQL, etc.) and feel comfortable transforming insights into business decisions.

You will be constantly seeking solutions that scale, while overseeing the growth of our business. Your processes and projects will directly contribute to DiDi growth in LATAM!

In this role, you'll be...


Support the execution of initiatives to bring back churned drivers, using data to identify opportunities and track results.
Help launch comeback incentives, communications and product initiatives for driver reactivation.
Constantly generate knowledge through experimental testing.
Manage data dashboards and analyze performance of driver strategies, to drive insights and business decisions.
Support the management of comeback incentives across Spanish Speaking LatAm, ensuring campaigns are launched correctly and on time.
Analyze campaign results and share learnings to improve future reactivation initiatives.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Currently studying Engineering, Computer science, Actuary, Economics or any related degree.
At least one year until graduation (ideally between 5th-8th Semester).

Diseñar y operar las comunicaciones de prevención de churn y reactivación, activando los modelos de propensión y las señales de comportamiento que se definen en conjunto con Growth/Lifecycles y Data, para recuperar usuarios inactivos y reducir el abandono de forma medible e incremental.

Ser dueño de la ejecución de las campañas de GTM y broadcast de Payments, colaborando con Producto, Marketing y Negocio en los calendarios de lanzamiento, mensajes y audiencias, para asegurar que cada lanzamiento llegue al usuario correcto, por el canal correcto y dentro de la política de contactabilidad.

Asegurar la operación de las comunicaciones transaccionales de Payments, definiendo el contenido y las alertas de negocio con Producto y Martech (dueño de la entrega y la infraestructura), para garantizar que confirmaciones, avisos y alertas de seguridad lleguen en tiempo y con evidencia.

Diseñar y ejecutar experimentos de comunicación, y apoyar los experimentos de producto y los ad hoc entre Producto y tienda, construyendo hipótesis en conjunto con Growth/Lifecycles y Producto, para generar aprendizajes accionables que mejoren conversión y adopción.

Gestionar la capacidad de su agenda, reservando explícitamente espacio para experimentos ad hoc e incidentes transaccionales dentro del modelo de intake, para no comprometer los entregables planeados.

Medir y reportar el desempeño de las comunicaciones a su cargo, usando Braze, herramientas de product analytics y la data del lake, para compartir aprendizajes con Growth/Lifecycles y Producto y optimizar continuamente.
Colaborar con Data y Martech, definiendo los eventos, atributos y segmentos que requieren sus journeys, para que las campañas se basen en comportamiento real y se puedan automatizar.
Proponer e impulsar casos de uso de automatización y campañas agénticas, identificando procesos manuales y repetitivos, para escalar la operación sin crecer en proporción al volumen.

Asegurar el cumplimiento normativo y de contactabilidad, aplicando la política de contactabilidad, las preferencias del usuario y las exclusiones (REUS, REPEP, derechos ARCO), y validando con Legal y Cumplimiento el contenido de productos financieros, para proteger al usuario y a la marca.
Dar feedback y dirección a equipos creativos y de contenido, compartiendo insights de usuario y buenas prácticas por canal, para elevar la calidad y relevancia de las comunicaciones.

About Us

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.

AI at SharkNinja 

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

About The Role

The Social GTM Manager sits at the center of SharkNinja's social ecosystem, ensuring our organic, influencer, paid social, affiliate, creator commerce, listening, and analytics teams operate as one integrated growth engine.

This role is equal parts strategist, operator, and connector. You will translate business priorities into coordinated social activation, ensuring product launches, retail moments, campaigns, creator programs, media investments, and commercial priorities are aligned and executed seamlessly across channels.

You are not a channel owner — you're the connective tissue. Working across Social, Media, Brand, Retail, E-Commerce, Communications, Product, and Analytics, you'll create the systems, planning processes, reporting frameworks, and operating rhythms that allow our teams to move faster, stay aligned, and maximize impact.

If you thrive on bringing order to complexity, love connecting teams around a common goal, and get energy from helping high-performing organizations operate at their best, this role is for you.

What You'll Do


Own and maintain the global social GTM calendar across organic, influencer, paid social, affiliate, creator commerce, listening, and analytics.
Build integrated launch plans that connect social activity to product launches, retail moments, promotional events, media investments, and broader business priorities.
Ensure creators, content, media, and commerce strategies are coordinated from planning through execution.
Partner with category, channel, and regional leaders to identify opportunities for amplification, integration, and scale.


Cross-Functional Orchestration

Drive launch readiness across social workstreams, ensuring timelines, dependencies, approvals, and deliverables remain on track.
Surface risks, gaps, and opportunities early, helping teams proactively solve problems before they impact execution.
Ensure social plans are integrated into broader marketing and commercial initiatives.


Social Ecosystem Excellence


Connect organic, influencer, paid social, affiliate, and creator commerce efforts into a cohesive full-funnel activation strategy.
Partner with Media teams to ensure creator, influencer, and organic content are leveraged effectively across paid channels.
Support the development of scalable playbooks, processes, and operating models that improve performance and speed.
Help evolve Social from a collection of channels into a measurable business growth engine.


Reporting & Business Intelligence


Own reporting cadences across the social ecosystem, including weekly updates, launch recaps, monthly business reviews, and executive communications.
Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into activity, performance, and business impact.
Translate social performance into clear, actionable insights for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Standardize reporting processes across regions, categories, and channels.


Process & Operations


Build and document workflows, launch processes, briefing templates, approval chains, and operational playbooks.
Identify operational inefficiencies and implement scalable solutions that improve visibility, accountability, and execution quality.
Manage intake processes and prioritization frameworks for social support requests.
Continuously improve how the social organization plans, communicates, and executes globally.


Attributes & Skills (Requirements)


5+ years of experience in Integrated Marketing, Social Media, Marketing Operations, GTM, Program Management, or related disciplines.
Strong understanding of the modern social ecosystem, including organic social, influencer marketing, paid social, affiliate marketing, creator commerce, social listening, and analytics.
Experience connecting marketing activity to business outcomes, product launches, retail priorities, and commercial objectives.
Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders simultaneously.
Strong analytical mindset and comfort translating data into actionable business insights.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level communications and stakeholder management.
Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional teams without direct authority.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with ambiguity and changing priorities.
Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as Asana, Monday, Notion, Airtable, Smartsheet, or similar.


What Success In This Role Looks Like


Product launches, campaigns, creator activations, and retail moments are coordinated seamlessly across the social ecosystem.

description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

As our AI Native Marketer, you own acquisition for Noa Notes: everything from the first time a doctor sees Noa to the moment they sign up and start their first session. That means ads and creatives, landing pages and the pitch on them, emails to our own database of doctors, newsletters, partners and new channels. You are a 360 marketer, not a paid-ads specialist.

Cheap sign-ups are not the goal. Doctors should arrive educated and motivated, knowing what Noa does and ready to try it. We judge acquisition quality by what happens in their first session. Onboarding, activation and conversion to paid stay with product, and you work closely with them. You own the number (quality sign-ups at a CAC we can scale); channels are your choice.

We're looking for a hands-on growth marketer who has owned an acquisition number and built the machine behind it. Think of how the fastest-growing AI apps run growth: one person with agents doing what used to take a team. Specifically, someone who:


Builds, not just manages. You build your own AI workflows and agents to produce content, launch campaigns, coordinate suppliers, and buy media at a volume a traditional team can't match.
Treats SaaS ads like e-commerce. Lots of creatives, fast tests, creative as the targeting, hard CAC discipline, measured on quality, not only volume.
Sets up tracking before spending. No euro goes out until we can tie it to a sign-up and what that doctor did next
Has creative taste. You know what makes a hook stop the scroll and you care about craft.
Gets to new channels early. Creators, newsletters, and getting Noa cited by AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity.


How will you make an impact?

Yes, it’s a lot. We believe one person with the right AI setup can now do what used to take a team, and you’ll take it over step by step.

Ads & Creative


Produce a high volume of creatives every week: UGC-style videos, doctor testimonials, demos of Noa writing a note live, static ads, carousels.
Use AI tools (Claude, image, video and voice generation, editing tools) to go from idea to live ad in hours, not weeks.
Launch and run paid campaigns on Meta, Google (Search, YouTube, PMax), TikTok and LinkedIn, e-commerce style: broad targeting, creative as the targeting.


Landing Pages & Pitch


Own the Noa web pages and landing pages: the pitch, the copy and the sub-pages for each specialty, country and use case, so doctors arrive knowing what Noa does and why it’s worth trying today.
Build and A/B test landing pages and sign-up flows for every campaign, in the languages of our markets.


Email & Our Own Database


Turn the ~500K doctors on Docplanner marketplaces into Noa users with email, in-product and WhatsApp campaigns, segmented by specialty and country.
Build nurture flows for doctors who visited or signed up but never started their first session.


Partners & New Channels (partially supported by the broader marketing team)


Launch affiliates/referrals, newsletter sponsorships, medical communities, podcasts and partnerships with medical associations, universities and congresses.
Run creator and doctor-influencer programmes.
Make Noa the answer when doctors ask ChatGPT, Perplexity or Gemini for an AI scribe or a clinical question, and build SEO content from Evidence.


Measure & Improve every week


Set up tracking before spending: pixels, conversion API, UTMs and events into Amplitude and HubSpot, so every channel is tied to sign-ups, first-session activity and, later, paying doctors.
Run a weekly test cadence across channels, pages and messages; kill losers fast, scale winners.
Report cost per sign-up and sign-up quality (first-session activity) by country and channel, and work with product on what happens next.


Build your own machine


Automate content production, campaign set-up, emails, sponsorship buying and reporting with agents and no-code tools, so a team of one moves like a team of five.


Who You Are

We’re looking for someone with 2 years in growth, performance or lifecycle marketing, at a startup, an agency or on your own projects. You’ve owned a number and moved it. We care more about what you’ve built and how fast you learn than about your CV.

Must-haves


You’ve owned an acquisition number (CAC, sign-ups, paying users), even at small scale, and improved it: first results, then iteration. Bring numbers.
You’ve run paid campaigns on Meta and/or Google with real money (a few thousand euros a month is fine) and tested creatives at volume.
You build with AI every day: image, video and voice tools, Claude, automations. Show us something you made.
Creative taste: you can write a hook that stops the scroll and tell a good ad from a bad one.
Comfortable with numbers: you want to know which channel brings what quality, and what it cost.
Fluent English. Spanish or Portuguese is a strong plus.


Nice-to-haves


You’ve set up tracking: pixels, conversion API, UTMs, GA4/Amplitude.
You’ve built a landing page yourself (Webflow, Framer or code).
You’ve written email campaigns or nurture flows (HubSpot, Mailchimp or similar).
You’ve run an affiliate, referral or creator programme (even a small one), or made UGC-style content yourself.
Interest in healthcare or in selling to professionals such as doctors.


How You Work


High energy and bias to shipping: ten small tests beat one perfect plan.
Scale what works: push budget fast on winners, find the ceiling, fix what broke.
Quality over volume: you’d rather bring 100 doctors who use Noa than 1,000 who never open it.
You own the number and say when something is not working.
You care about doctors and respect that this is healthcare: claims are accurate and patient data is protected.


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner Giuliana, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣ Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and AI experience with Gerard, Chief of Staff for AI Solutions. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind - it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

3️⃣Additional Interview - Another deeper conversation about Marketing with Marta, our CMO.

4️⃣Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Final Interview – A final conversation with Karol, VP of AI Solutions.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:


Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

Description

Amazon is looking for a talented, smart, experienced and enthusiastic Marketing Manager to help develop and grow our Category marketing business in Mexico. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in an exciting new team structure.

The successful candidate will develop strategies and managing the execution of acquisition, engagement and retention initiatives, primarily via online channels including push notifications, emails, onsite experience, SEO, internal search, affiliate marketing, social media and mobile.

Candidate is expected to improve key product features (Search, IDQ, Personalization, Fit, Detail Page, RCX...) by working cross-functionally across Emerging marketplaces stakeholders. You will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment, and able to think big while paying careful attention to detail.

Key job responsibilities

Main KPIs are: traffic, acquisition, customer active base, settlement and lapsed rates. Responsibilities:


 Lead site merchandising for all categories across MX - develop and execute merchandising activities, manage navigation structure, create pages and merchandising features to support coop initiatives, coordinate and support promotional events and marketing campaigns.
 Lead several programs for customer acquisition and engagement, partnering with several tech teams
 Work closely with the traffic teams to drive customers and sales to our store, including gateway, outbound, associates, search, social media.
 Design, lead and implement customer experience enhancement/improvement projects.
 Create and analyze performance metrics and making business decisions about future direction based on performance and ROI
 Partner with various technical and business teams to build supporting automation
 Own weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting of key content and marketing metrics to the leadership team and broader organization.


The ideal candidate will be innovative, team oriented, an effective communicator across functions and levels, have a desire to participate in change, and appreciate a highly entrepreneurial environment with rapidly changing priorities. We are seeking someone with proven track record in project and stakeholder management, deep analytical skills, and ability to simplify and scale.

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
 7+ years of developing and managing acquisition marketing or channel programs experience
 Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
 Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
 Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
 Experience developing and executing campaigns across a multitude of timezones and languages
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
 Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Excellent communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Partner with vendors to produce content that aligns with Citi goals and deliver content to targeted audience
Work cross-functionally to develop partnership agreements in accordance with requirements of internal stakeholders
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Qualifications:


5-8 years of experience in content marketing, content editing or related field

Bachelors/University degree or equivalent experience


This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

Descripción del Rol

Especialista técnico-estratégico que coordina la implementación, activación y medición dentro del ecosistema Adobe Experience Cloud. Su responsabilidad es liderar la implementación, administración y optimización de Adobe Audience Manager y Adobe Target dentro del ecosistema digital, asegurando la correcta recopilación, activación y personalización de audiencias. For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Bachelor’s degree.

Advanced Excel skills.  
Strong analytical and numerical skills. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

For Mexico

This position is available in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality. The candidate must perform their work from any location within Mexico. For Colombia

description:
Buscamos una persona curiosa, autodidacta y orientada a la acción para liderar nuestras estrategias con creadores de contenido. Tu misión será identificar, negociar y gestionar colaboraciones con influencers y creadores de contenido, asegurando que cada campaña sea medida, optimizada y alineada con los valores de nuestra marca. No buscamos a alguien que solo siga un manual, sino a un perfil con criterio profesional que sepa navegar la incertidumbre del ecosistema digital.




Responsabilidades Principales:




1. Estrategia y Gestión de Campañas

Identificación y Selección: Identificar influencers y creadores de contenido mediante análisis de datos, métricas de afinidad y relevancia.
Gestión Integral (End-to-End): Coordinar colaboraciones desde la negociación de presupuestos y contratos hasta la aprobación de contenidos, facturación y seguimiento de pagos.
Ejecución Operativa: Crear briefs de campaña claros, controlar timelines en herramientas como Odoo y asegurar el cumplimiento de entregables.
Relacionamiento: Detectar y fortalecer vínculos con agencias de representación y creadores clave.

2. Análisis y Optimización

Reporteo: Evaluar los resultados de las campañas (Engagement, CPM, ROI, tráfico web, etc.) y elaborar informes con insights accionables.
Mejora Continua: Identificar qué funciona y qué no, proponiendo ajustes estratégicos basados en datos y tendencias de plataformas (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube).

3. Colaboración Interna

Actuar como puente entre los departamentos de Contabilidad, Legal, Diseño, Eventos y PR para asegurar la coherencia de las acciones.




Requisitos: 




Inglés: Nivel Avanzado.
Plataformas: Dominio experto de redes sociales y deseable manejo de herramientas de gestión (Aspire, Upfluence, CreatorIQ o similares).
Análisis de Datos: Manejo de Google Sheets y comprensión profunda de métricas (Reach, ROI, Revenue).
Gestión Administrativa: Conocimientos básicos de contratos, facturación y control de costos.
Soft Skills Clave: Negociación, atención al detalle, autonomía y una comunicación abierta y transparente.




Deseable: 




Mentalidad Exploradora: Alguien que siempre busque el "por qué" y el "cómo" de las cosas.
Inteligencia Práctica: Capacidad de adaptar las mejores prácticas a situaciones reales, no solo "by the book".
Optimismo Realista: Energía para proponer soluciones viables frente a los problemas.

description:
🇲🇽 USD 18,000 to USD 22,000 per year on a full-time-equivalent basis, pro-rated for a three-day working week, depending on experience, on a part-time contractor contract.

🌎 Fully remote working from anywhere in Mexico!

✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment

💻 Work with modern hardware, social publishing tools, productivity systems, and AI-enabled workflows.




Working Hours




Your regular schedule will be Tuesday, Thursday and Friday, 3:00pm–12:00am Pacific Time. From January 2027, the regular working days will change to Monday, Thursday and Friday, at the same hours.




You will also need some flexibility to provide occasional cover on other weekdays when teammates are out of office. Any additional cover will be agreed in advance.




Who We Are 




Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.

Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We produce social content at scale, support major entertainment brands, build products, and keep improving how our teams work.




We are remote-first, fast-moving, and increasingly AI-native in how we operate. AI tools and agentic workflows are becoming part of the way our teams plan, check, coordinate, research, report, and improve work. The standard is not “let AI do it”. The standard is better work: clearer briefs, faster execution, sharper checks, stronger judgment, and repeatable workflows that keep quality high.




About The Role 




We are hiring an AI Social Media Coordinator to help run the day-to-day social presence of major US TV and entertainment brands.

The craft is familiar: scheduling, reviewing, coordinating, optimising, checking, escalating, and keeping content moving. How we do that work is changing fast.




This is not a pure creative content role and it is not passive admin. The core of the job is client-safe social media operations: making sure content is scheduled, checked, approved, published, documented, and improved with strong attention to detail.




You will first learn what good looks like for our clients and why it matters. Then you will work with Storm’s social tools, workflow systems, and AI-enabled ways of working to help make the role faster, clearer, and more reliable.




The strongest candidates will already be practical and curious about AI. We are not looking for someone who uses AI only as a search box or autocomplete. We are looking for someone who can brief tools carefully, use them for bounded pieces of work, review what comes back with a critical eye, and keep improving how they use them.




If that already feels like how you work, this role is likely to suit you.




What You’ll Make Happen 

Put the client experience and publishing accuracy at the heart of everything you do.
Optimise YouTube content with effective titles, thumbnails, copy, metadata, and publishing checks.
Schedule, review, and coordinate social content across YouTube channels and social networks.
Support day-to-day community management across client social channels by monitoring and responding to audience comments and messages in line with agreed brand guidance, and escalating sensitive or complex interactions appropriately.
Clear dependencies proactively, including assets, copy, captions, approvals, account access, platform requirements, timings, and client expectations.
Coordinate with client contacts and Storm’s content production, copywriting, captioning, and social teams so work moves without avoidable gaps or surprises.
Use AI tools and workflow systems to support repeatable coordination work, including calendar planning, dependency chasing, content checks, research, account audits, reporting, and documentation.
Review AI-assisted work critically before it reaches clients, platforms, or internal stakeholders.
Research clients’ shows, movies, channels, competitors, and audiences so social recommendations are grounded in useful context.
Monitor social platform updates and identify practical changes that matter for client accounts.
Help document and improve internal processes so that good ways of working become repeatable across the team.
Escalate clearly when something is blocked, risky, unclear, late, or outside your authority, bringing evidence and a sensible next step.




Your Expertise 

Hands-on social media coordination, publishing, community, content operations, or adjacent digital experience.
Practical AI fluency: you have used AI tools in real work, study, or personal projects, and can explain how you check their output.
Strong attention to detail, especially around copy, timing, assets, approvals, account selection, links, platform requirements, and final pre-publish checks.
Clear written communication and the ability to explain what is done, what is blocked, what is risky, and what needs a decision.
Strong organisation and workload management across multiple accounts, deadlines, and stakeholders.
Comfort using social publishing tools, spreadsheets, project management systems, documentation, and other workflow tools.
A systems mindset: you see repeated work as something that can be made clearer, safer, and more efficient.
Curiosity about social platforms, audience behaviour, entertainment brands, and the changing AI tooling landscape.
Sound judgment about when to act independently, when to ask, when to escalate, and when not to publish.
Ability to analyse information qualitatively and quantitatively, then turn it into useful recommendations.
High agency: you do not wait passively for perfect instructions when there is a sensible next step to take.




What Success Looks Like 

Content goes out on the right account, at the right time, with the right assets, copy, metadata, approvals, and platform checks.
Client contacts and internal teams trust you because your updates are clear, accurate, and useful.
You catch issues early: missing assets, unclear approvals, broken links, platform constraints, scheduling conflicts, weak copy, mismatched account details, or risky assumptions.
You use AI and workflow tools to make repeatable work faster and more reliable, without handing over judgment.
You improve the operating system around the work: checklists, documentation, calendar views, QA steps, escalation routes, reporting, and lessons learned.
You distinguish urgent execution from optional strategy, and you know how to keep both moving at the right level.
You make the team calmer and more effective because the details are visible, controlled, and followed through.




This Role Will Suit You If

You enjoy the operational side of social media: coordination, publishing, QA, process, timing, and follow-through.
You like using modern tools to make repeated work more reliable.
You care about accuracy and client trust as much as you care about ideas.
You are comfortable working across multiple accounts and deadlines without losing detail.
You want to work in an AI-native team and are ready to bring those methods into everyday social media coordination.
You can take feedback, improve your process, and keep raising your own standard.




This Role Will Not Suit You If

You mainly want a creative strategy role with little day-to-day coordination.
You are uncomfortable with detailed checks, repeated processes, or publishing accountability.
You treat AI-generated output as finished work without reviewing it.
You wait for someone else to notice problems that you could reasonably have surfaced.
You prefer broad social media opinions over client-safe execution and evidence-backed recommendations.




What It’s Like to Work Here 




Modern Tools And Working Methods

Work with current hardware, social tools, productivity systems, and a properly supported AI stack. You will be expected to learn the tools, use them thoughtfully, and help improve how the work gets done.




Agility And Openness For Ideas

We actively encourage people to bring forward ideas that improve how teams work. We value practical experimentation, quick learning, and clear follow-through.




Client And Audience Impact

Our work supports major entertainment brands. Small details can matter: timing, approvals, links, copy, thumbnails, account selection, and platform rules all affect trust.




Remote-First Working

This role is fully remote within Mexico. Your normal workday will start at 3pm Pacific Time.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS 




First, you will receive questions to answer via a self-recorded video.




If successful, we will invite you to an interview (60 minutes via MS Teams). During the meeting, Bella, our Head of Social Media Management, will get to know you and try to understand if you’d be a good fit for the role, and at the same time answer all your questions.




Following this, there will be a short task to test your attention to detail and communication skills.

There may also be a short (30 minutes via MS Teams) follow-up interview with Duncan, our Chief Operating Officer.




And that’s it!

Stay’d

Stay’d is a consortium of best-in-class short-term rental management companies building one unified brand across multiple US markets. You build and run the engine and hand warm responses to sales; this is not a cold-calling seat. Sending a campaign is not the same as filling the pipeline. If a channel is yours, you own its cost per signed owner.

You sit in Marketing and report to the Marketing Director, working closely with the SDR and sales team, and with the brand teams across the collective.

title: AI Enablement Manager
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The AI Enablement Manager helps enterprise customers turn AI from a product capability into real business outcomes. You will work with customers and internal teams to understand problems, design AI-powered solutions, deploy them in real business environments, measure performance, and continuously improve results with data and AI tools.

This is not a traditional customer success role, and it is not a narrow delivery role. You will operate more like an AI field deployment owner: close to customers, close to product, close to data, and accountable for making AI actually work in the field.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Understand real business problems. Work directly with customers to clarify workflows, pain points, success metrics, and operational challenges, then turn ambiguous needs into structured AI use cases and action plans.

• Design and deploy AI solutions. Use the WIZ.AI platform to design, configure, test, and launch AI Talkbot solutions, including flows, prompts, rules, logic, escalation paths, test cases, and performance checks.

• Use AI tools to move faster and better. Apply AI tools to accelerate requirement analysis, demo preparation, conversation drafting, call data analysis, feedback summarization, issue diagnosis, and optimization ideas.

• Own the loop from launch to value. Monitor performance after go-live, identify issues, collect feedback, and improve the solution until customers see measurable value in adoption, experience, efficiency, or business outcomes.

• Work across teams to solve problems. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Support, and Customer Success teams to unblock issues and improve outcomes.

• Discover the next AI opportunity. As you learn the customer business, proactively identify where AI can create more value through optimization, new use cases, renewal, or expansion.




You may be a strong fit if you have:

• Curious about AI, enterprise software, automation, or digital transformation

• Clear communicator with customers and internal teams

• Structured problem solver

• Ownership: care about outcomes, not just tasks

• Self-driven when the path is unclear

• Fast learner, adaptable, and comfortable with ambiguity




Nice to have, but not required:

• Projects or internships in consulting, SaaS, customer success, project management, business analysis, software testing, or AI-related work

• Use of AI tools for research, analysis, coding, workflow automation, or project work

• Basics of LLMs, NLP, prompt engineering, conversation design, UX, flowcharts, or system logic

• Excel, SQL, Python, or basic data analysis




WHAT YOU WILL GAIN

This role gives you end-to-end exposure to enterprise AI adoption. You will learn how AI solutions are discovered, designed, deployed, measured, optimized, and expanded. You will work with real customers, real data, real business pressure, and real AI use cases.

• Build AI-native problem-solving habits: use AI tools to improve speed, quality, analysis, and execution.

• Develop customer-facing capability: communicate with enterprise stakeholders and turn business problems into practical solutions.

• Grow into broader paths: AI solution consulting, field deployment, customer success leadership, product operations, business operations, or AI transformation.




WHY JOIN US

Many graduate roles give you a small task in a large process. This role gives you the full loop: diagnose problems, build AI-powered solutions, launch them, measure impact, and keep improving until customers see value.

If you want to grow fast, work close to real business, and become an AI-native problem solver, this is a role where you can start building that capability from day one.

description:
Senior Account Manager | Ciudad de México




En FCM Travel ayudamos a algunas de las organizaciones más importantes del mundo a optimizar y transformar sus programas de viajes corporativos. Como parte de Flight Centre Travel Group, combinamos alcance global, innovación tecnológica y experiencia local para generar resultados medibles para nuestros clientes en más de 90 países. Creemos que la gestión de cuentas va más allá del servicio al cliente. Se trata de convertirse en un socio estratégico capaz de generar valor, impulsar resultados y construir relaciones de largo plazo con algunas de las organizaciones más importantes del mundo.




Actualmente buscamos un Senior Account Manager para integrarse a nuestro equipo en Ciudad de México.




Responsabilidades principales:




Gestionar una cartera de cuentas estratégicas clasificadas como A, AA, AAA y Key Accounts.
Desarrollar relaciones sólidas con Travel Managers y tomadores de decisión de áreas como Finanzas, Compras, Recursos Humanos, Administración y Dirección General.
Analizar el comportamiento de compra de los clientes para identificar oportunidades de ahorro, eficiencia y crecimiento.
Liderar revisiones ejecutivas de negocio (Account Reviews) y presentar recomendaciones respaldadas por información y resultados.
Monitorear indicadores de desempeño, cumplimiento de SLA's y planes de mejora continua.
Identificar oportunidades de expansión mediante la promoción de soluciones, herramientas y servicios de FCM.
Participar en renovaciones contractuales y negociaciones comerciales.
Coordinar iniciativas internas para asegurar una experiencia excepcional para el cliente.




¿Quién eres?




Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en Account Management, Customer Success Enterprise o gestión de cuentas corporativas de alto valor.
Experiencia administrando cuentas nacionales y/o multinacionales.
Capacidad comprobada para construir relaciones con múltiples stakeholders y niveles organizacionales.
Sólidas habilidades de negociación, análisis de información y presentación ejecutiva.
Experiencia trabajando con indicadores de negocio, métricas de desempeño y revisiones periódicas con clientes.
Inglés profesional mínimo nivel B2.




¿Qué experiencia aportas?




Travel Management Companies (TMCs).
Viajes corporativos.
Gestión de programas de viaje.
GDS (Amadeus, Sabre o Travelport).
Herramientas de gestión comercial como Salesforce.
Gestión de cuentas regionales o globales.




Importante




Esta posición está orientada a profesionales que hayan gestionado relaciones comerciales estratégicas y complejas. Si tu experiencia se ha desarrollado principalmente en funciones operativas, atención al cliente transaccional o ventas enfocadas exclusivamente en prospección de nuevos clientes, probablemente esta posición no sea el mejor ajuste.




Si te interesa formar parte de una organización global donde podrás influir directamente en la estrategia, crecimiento y satisfacción de clientes corporativos de gran escala, nos gustaría conocerte.




Ubicación: Ciudad de México

 Modalidad: Presencial con 1 día de Home office.

description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 6,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Analyst, Technical Customer Manager - FSI

Why We Have This Role

The Technical Customer Manager plays a pivotal part in Qualtrics' success by leading the design, delivery and ongoing success of customer’s experience programs, focused on driving measurable business impact. In this role, you will partner with customers throughout their lifecycle - from program delivery and onboarding to ongoing optimization, adoption and value realization. You will act as the primary technology trusted advisor for your portfolio, leading medium and large-scale software implementations and optimizing our technology to address individual challenges, ultimately building our customers into lifelong Qualtrics champions.

How You'll Find Success

You will find success by blending exceptional customer and project management skills with a focus on technical platform adoption, renewals, and expansion. You will lead project teams to deliver complex programs within our specific Industry Verticals and Region, ensuring your customers deepen and broaden their usage of the platform. By influencing customers to shape their feedback programs and being resourceful when facing challenges, you will drive leading indicators of success, value realization, and Net ARR growth.

How You’ll Grow


Master advanced technical implementation: You will develop deep, hands-on expertise in the Qualtrics platform, evolving into a trusted technology advisor who leads medium and large-scale enterprise software implementations.
Elevate your executive influence and consulting skills: You will build strong relationships with senior customer program owners and decision-makers, honing your ability to shape strategic feedback programs and guide large, complex organizations through business transformations.
Develop commercial and portfolio leadership: By proactively monitoring account health and defining expansion strategies, you will move beyond standard project execution to directly drive portfolio performance, value realization, and account growth.
Expand your cross-functional and industry footprint: You will act as the critical bridge collaborating internally with project managers, engineering, account executive and product teams, while deepening your specialized knowledge of significant industry shifts taking place in experience management.


Things You'll Do


Portfolio Leadership: Own the success of a portfolio of customer accounts, serving as the primary technology advisor throughout the customer lifecycle
Portfolio Performance: Monitor portfolio performance using customer health, adoption, maturity and value realisation to proactively manage risk and identify growth opportunities
Account Growth & Maturity: Define strategy to expand program adoption and maturity across our customer accounts, driving Net ARR and portfolio performance
Strategic Project Management: Partner with customers to provide expertise leading to the alignment of project goals and timely execution
Risk & Quality Management: Plan, monitor, and mitigate project risks while developing quality management plans aligned with business requirements
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams to support your customer’s experience and maintain account health


What We're Looking For On Your Resume

The ideal candidate combines technical expertise, consulting skills and a passion for helping customers transform their business through technology.


3+ years of experience: Successfully working with large, complex organisations to execute and advise on customer facing programs that deliver sustainable business outcomes 
Technical Aptitude: High interest in learning the Qualtrics platform and new technologies and deployment of technical expertise with customers at scale
Consulting & Program Management: Proven ability to plan and execute multiple concurrent projects on time and budget, with a blend of consulting and internal-customer experience. Collaborating with project managers, consultants, architects and product teams to support delivery of specific outcomes
Customer Engagement: Ability to lead workshops, knowledge transfer sessions, utilise data and metrics to communicate understanding and produce high quality customer facing documentation 
Stakeholder Influence: Ability to build relationships with senior customer program owners and decision makers
Industry Experience: Good understanding of significant industry shifts taking place in experience management in one or more specific industries. 
Entrepreneurial spirit: High tolerance for ambiguity and complexity. Ability to be efficient with limited resources, to understand business needs and to communicate and present to Senior Management effectively.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering, or business-related field.
Willingness to Travel: Able to travel up to 25% to engage with clients and teams.


Key Responsibilities

What You Should Know About This Team

Help Customers Grow


Build and maintain strong customer stakeholder relationships to deeply understand the context, ambition and strategic business goals for the customers within your portfolio
Define and execute your strategy for retaining, maturing and expanding customer accounts; including assessing customer usage and implementing new capabilities to enhance their programs
Develop success plans aligned with customer business goals and technology roadmaps
Monitor customer health, platform utilisation and adoption metrics to identify opportunities for increased value 
Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement to drive high quality customer outcomes

Provide Technical & Execution Expertise


Develop and maintain technical competence on the Qualtrics platform, ensuring a deep understanding of the leading indicators of customer adoption, ACV retention and value realisation
Utilize experience and best practices in order to understand the customer and communicate effectively how the Qualtrics platform will support the delivery of value driving outcomes and enhance their program
Lead specific project implementations for new customers to your portfolio and existing customers; including cross functional / cross team project teams consisting of Technical Services Consultants and XM Advisors, with the objective to deliver on project goals and objectives
Conduct regular risk planning, monitoring, mitigation and reporting to stakeholders both during project delivery and account lifecycle

Demonstrate Operational Rigor


Execute implementation and account management activities in accordance with global standard practices, ensuring rigorous account and project tracking and proactive risk and issue management
Ensure all project and account documentation and artefacts are developed, maintained 
Stay current with product and strategic customer journey enhancements 

Key Success Measures

For customer accounts within your portfolio over a 12 month period:

Customer Value


Net ARR 
Customer adoption and maturity of customer account
Customer satisfaction and advocacy

Successful Execution


Billable Utilization attainment
Time to Value for customers following delivery of new capabilities (measured by level of consumption 60 days following go-live milestone)
Time to Deliver new capabilities for customers in your portfolio
Rigorous scope management measured by level of Variance on Completion (VAC) of specific project deliverables

Our Team’s Favorite Perks And Benefits


Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision insurance packages for you and your dependents.
Professional Growth & Mentorship: Structured onboarding, product training, and clear pathways for career advancement. 
Paid Time Off & Holidays: Generous paid vacation, sick leave, and paid company holidays


The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid

title: Lead Retention Specialist
description:
Join One of the Fastest-Growing Online Education Companies in the World

At ELVTR, we're transforming online education by connecting ambitious professionals with industry leaders from companies like Nike, Netflix, Google, Amazon, and more.

Since launching in 2020, we've grown into a global learning community with over 300 expert instructors, delivering more than 200 live online courses across 12 industries. To date, we've helped 22,000+ graduates worldwide gain the skills, confidence, and connections needed to advance their careers.

Now we're looking for an experienced Lead Retention Specialist to help us build lasting relationships with our learners while maximizing customer satisfaction and long-term revenue. If you're passionate about customer experience, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy finding solutions that create value for both customers and the business, we'd love to meet you.

This is a full-time, remote role with a working schedule for this role will be 9AM-6 PM EST.

Why This Role Is Different

At ELVTR, customer relationships don't end after enrollment—they're just beginning. As our Lead Retention Specialist, you'll play a critical role in protecting the customer experience while driving sustainable business growth.

You'll take ownership of our retention strategy, helping customers find the best possible solutions while reducing refunds, recovering revenue, and improving long-term customer loyalty. Working closely with Sales, Finance, Customer Success, Billing, and Operations, you'll use data, empathy, and strategic thinking to continuously improve our retention processes and outcomes.

You'll Love This Role If You

Enjoy solving complex customer challenges with creative solutions

Thrive in a fast-paced, KPI-driven environment

Are an exceptional negotiator who can create win-win outcomes

Love using data to improve processes and business performance

Enjoy coaching others and sharing best practices

Are highly organized and take ownership of your work

Communicate confidently with customers and cross-functional teams

Believe outstanding customer experiences drive long-term business success

What You'll Do

Own the customer retention process, managing refund requests while maximizing retained revenue and delivering a positive customer experience

Negotiate alternatives to refunds, including account credits, payment plans, partial refunds, course transfers, and other retention solutions

Recover overdue installment payments by proactively engaging customers and resolving billing-related issues

Partner closely with the Billing team to reduce payment defaults, chargebacks, and outstanding balances

Analyze the root causes behind refund requests and payment failures, providing actionable insights to Sales, Product, and Operations teams

Develop and continuously improve retention strategies, workflows, communication scripts, and internal processes

Track and report key retention metrics, including refund rates, retention rates, recovered revenue, installment recovery, and chargeback prevention

Handle escalated customer cases, making thoughtful, data-driven decisions that balance customer satisfaction with business objectives

Coach and support the retention team by sharing best practices, reviewing customer interactions, and maintaining high communication standards

Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Operations to ensure a seamless customer experience

Identify opportunities to automate retention processes and improve operational efficiency

Take ownership of retention KPIs while testing and implementing initiatives that improve revenue recovery and reduce financial losses

Requirements

What We're Looking For

3+ years of experience in Sales Retention, Customer Retention, Customer Success, or a related field, preferably in a senior or lead role

Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken

Proven experience supporting customers in the US market

Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills with a track record of reducing refunds and recovering revenue

Experience managing refund requests, payment recovery, billing issues, and installment collections

Ability to navigate difficult customer conversations with empathy while protecting company interests

A data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze retention metrics and identify opportunities for improvement

Strong ownership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

Experience collaborating with Sales, Billing, Finance, Customer Success, and other cross-functional teams

Previous leadership, mentoring, or process improvement experience is a strong plus

Nice to Have

Experience in the online education or EdTech industry

Experience in high-ticket B2C sales environments

Previous experience leading or mentoring a retention team

Familiarity with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar systems

Experience working with subscription or installment payment models

Knowledge of billing operations, chargebacks, and payment recovery processes

Experience analyzing customer retention metrics to drive business improvements

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Experience collaborating across Sales, Finance, Product, and Customer Success teams

Familiarity with AI-powered customer support or sales tools, including conversation intelligence platforms

Benefits

What We Offer

Competitive Compensation :Competitive salary,Performance-based bonuses,Opportunities for career advancement as ELVTR continues to grow globally

Learn and Grow :Free access to ELVTR courses,Ongoing professional development opportunities,Career growth within one of the world's fastest-growing online education companies

Remote-First Culture

Work from wherever you're most productive, Flexible and supportive work environment,Collaborative international team

Health & Wellbeing: Gym membership reimbursement,Mental health support, Generous paid vacation allowance

Why Join ELVTR?

Make an Impact: Every course you help create empowers professionals to build new skills, advance their careers, and unlock opportunities they never thought possible.

Grow Your Career:We're

committed to developing our people. As ELVTR continues to expand globally, you'll have opportunities to grow professionally, take on new challenges, and shape the future of online education.

Join a Winning Team: Work alongside passionate educators, creators, marketers, and innovators who are committed to delivering world-class learning experiences and making education more accessible around the world.

Ready to Help Shape the Future of Online Learning?

If you're looking for more than just another customer retention role—if you want to build meaningful customer relationships, solve complex challenges, and make a measurable impact on both learners and business growth—we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of ELVTR's next chapter of growth.

ELVTR is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace for all.

About the company

The company is a fast-growing AI startup that turns fragmented operational and document-based data into a single source of truth, enabling AI agents to run end-to-end workflows for B2B companies. The company lands with a client in one area, then expands across the organization. description:
About Cognex

Cognex Corporation is the world’s leading provider of industrial machine vision systems, sensors, and enterprise barcode readers. Our technology infuses artificial intelligence and advanced optics into manufacturing and logistics processes, helping global automation leaders eliminate defects and track parts seamlessly. We operate in a highly dynamic, fast-paced environment where innovation, persistence, and teamwork drive our unmatched industry success.




Role Overview

As an Account Development Representative, you will be responsible for the localized execution of our Account-Based Marketing (ABM) outbound strategy. Operating within your assigned geographic region (e.g., Americas, EMEA, or Greater China), you will partner intensely with regional sales teams to break into high-priority enterprise accounts.

In addition to traditional high-value outbound prospecting, you will act as a modern revenue technologist. You will monitor, manage, and optimize automated digital agents executing front-line sequences, scaling our reach while maintaining brand and conversion quality.




Essential Functions & Responsibilities

ABM Outbound Strategy Execution: Execute highly tailored multi-channel outbound campaigns (phone, personalized email, social selling) targeting tier-one accounts within your assigned geographic region.
AI & Automation Agent Management: Supervise, review, and optimize automated outbound and inbound digital agents. Tweak sequences, manage intent-trigger responses, and continuously refine performance data.
Tight Sales & Marketing Alignment: Maintain a high cadence of collaboration with Field Sales Directors and Account Engineers to align on active campaigns, account priorities, and target buying centers.
On-Site Seminar Management: Drive attendance for on-site seminars at top-tier corporate accounts. Partner with local Field Sales and Technical Application Engineers who deliver the content.
Intent-Driven Prospecting: Utilize intent intelligence platforms to identify accounts showing active buying signals and deploy rapid-response outreach.
Account Mapping: Research and navigate highly complex industrial organizations to pinpoint key decision-makers—such as Plant Managers, Automation Engineers, Maintenance and Quality Directors.
Data & Tooling Integrity: Rigorously track and log all prospect interactions, account hierarchies, and pipeline metrics within our modern sales technology stack.
Technical Product Expertise: Develop and maintain knowledge of Cognex machine vision systems, AI software, industrial sensors, and barcode reading solutions to effectively qualify customer applications.




Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Your performance and impact will be measured across the following core metrics:

Target Account Engagement: Number of net-new relevant contacts and qualified meetings secured within designated target ABM accounts.
New Target Account Acquisition: Success rate in penetrating and opening up previously unengaged priority target accounts.
Pipeline Contribution: Total dollar value of qualified sales pipelines generated through outbound efforts and optimized automation sequences.




Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Language Proficiency: Must possess native-level written and verbal fluency in the primary language of the assigned country or region (e.g., Mandarin for Greater China, English for North America, etc.) to communicate effectively with enterprise stakeholders.
High Technology Fluency: Advanced proficiency in navigating enterprise-grade revenue tech stacks. You must be comfortable managing workflows across systems like Salesforce CRM, 6sense, Qualified, ZoomInfo, and Gong.
Automation Familiarity: Comfort or direct experience monitoring automated sales sequences, marketing automation tools, or AI-driven outreach platforms.
ABM Methodology Mastery: Deep understanding of Account-Based Marketing concepts, including multi-threaded prospecting, persona-based messaging, and identifying buying committees.
Analytical Mindset: Ability to read data dashboards, spot drop-offs in sequence performance, and proactively pivot messaging to optimize open and conversion rates.
Technical Solution Knowledge: Ability to understand and articulate complex technical products and qualify customer applications.




Minimum Education and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related industrial discipline.
2–5 years of experience in an outbound B2B tech BDR/SDR role, with a documented track record of executing ABM frameworks.
Experience selling into industrial manufacturing, logistics, automation, or enterprise hardware sectors is highly desirable.

title: Administrador de CRM y Automatización Digital (Dynamics, Power Platform, Copilot)
description:
Tareas Principales 

 Administración de Dynamics CRM

 

 ·       Fungir como administrador de Microsoft Dynamics CRM para Estados Unidos, Canadá y México.

·       Configurar y mantener formularios, vistas, campos, entidades, roles de seguridad, equipos y accesos de usuario.

·       Construir y mantener reglas de negocio, flujos de trabajo y etapas del proceso comercial que correspondan a la forma de vender de la región.

·       Administrar versiones y actualizaciones, probar los cambios en un ambiente de pruebas antes de producción y documentar cada cambio.

·       Coordinar con el administrador global de CRM todo lo que requiera un cambio global y presentar la justificación de negocio correspondiente.

·       Resolver con rapidez los problemas de los usuarios y dar seguimiento a los problemas recurrentes para corregirlos de raíz.

 

 Automatización de Procesos (Power Platform)

 

 ·       Diseñar y construir flujos de Power Automate que eliminen pasos manuales en cotización, captura de pedidos, asignación de prospectos, aprobaciones y seguimiento.

·       Construir aplicaciones y formularios sencillos en Power Apps cuando una pantalla resulte más rápida que una hoja de cálculo o una cadena de correos.

·       Conectar Dynamics, SharePoint, Outlook, Teams y Excel para que la información se capture una sola vez y se reutilice.

·       Monitorear los flujos en producción, corregir las fallas antes de que los usuarios las noten y mantener un registro de lo que está en operación y para qué.

·       Identificar trabajo manual en la región y proponer la automatización que lo elimine.

 

 Agentes de Copilot e Inteligencia Artificial

 

 ·       Construir y mantener agentes de Microsoft Copilot que respondan consultas rutinarias de ventas internas sobre productos, estructura de precios, tiempos de entrega y estatus de pedidos.

·       Construir agentes de servicio al cliente que redacten respuestas, obtengan información de pedidos y embarques y canalicen lo que requiere atención de una persona.

·       Construir agentes de reporteo que integren los reportes recurrentes de ventas, cartera y desempeño sin compilación manual.

·       Capacitar al equipo en Copilot y en Copilot dentro de CoWork para que usen las herramientas de forma correcta y segura.

·       Verificar la exactitud de las respuestas de los agentes antes de liberarlos y revisarlos de forma periódica.

·       Mantener el uso de los agentes dentro de las reglas de datos, seguridad y privacidad de la compañía.

 

 Implementación de Dynamics ERP (2027)

 

 ·       Actuar como el recurso técnico de Norteamérica en la implementación de Dynamics ERP.

·       Apoyar la limpieza, el mapeo y la migración de datos desde los sistemas actuales, incluido AS/400 en Houston.

·       Participar en las sesiones de diseño, documentar los requerimientos regionales y probar las configuraciones antes del arranque.

·       Desarrollar e impartir la capacitación a usuarios en español e inglés, y redactar las instrucciones de trabajo que los usuarios conservarán.

·       Brindar soporte directo durante el arranque y el periodo de estabilización posterior.

 

 Reporteo y Análisis de Datos

 

 ·       Construir y mantener reportes de ventas, oportunidades, cartera y actividad en Dynamics, Excel y Power BI.

·       Automatizar los reportes recurrentes para que lleguen a tiempo sin que nadie los arme.

·       Analizar la información de ventas y clientes y señalar lo que los números muestran, no únicamente lo que dicen.

·       Apoyar con datos confiables los ejercicios de presupuesto, pronóstico y revisión de desempeño de la región.

·       Coordinar con el equipo de Power BI en Francia los requerimientos de tableros regionales.

 

 Calidad y Gobierno de Datos

 

 ·       Ser responsable de la calidad de los datos de clientes, contactos, oportunidades y cuentas en el CRM.

·       Construir validaciones, campos obligatorios y controles de duplicados que impidan la entrada de datos incorrectos.

·       Realizar auditorías periódicas de asignación de cuentas, territorios e integridad de los registros.

·       Mantener los estándares de nomenclatura y la documentación para que los datos sigan siendo útiles conforme crezca el equipo.

 

 Capacitación, Adopción y Soporte a Usuarios

 

 ·       Capacitar a usuarios nuevos y actuales en Dynamics CRM, Power Automate y Copilot, en español e inglés.

·       Elaborar y mantener instrucciones de trabajo breves y guías rápidas de las herramientas que usa el equipo.

·       Sostener sesiones de trabajo periódicas con ventas, ventas internas y servicio al cliente para recoger lo que no está funcionando.

·       Dar seguimiento a la adopción y el uso, y acercarse directamente a los usuarios que necesiten apoyo.

·       Explicar temas técnicos en lenguaje sencillo a personas que no son técnicas.
