title: Senior Manager Digital Acquisition
description:
We don't think about job roles in a traditional way. We are anti-silo. Anti-career stagnation. Anti-conventional.

Beyond ONE is a digital services provider radically reshaping the personalised digital ecosystems of consumers in high growth markets around the world. We're building a digital services aggregator platform, with a strong telco foundation, and a profitable growth strategy that empowers users to drive their own experience—subscribe once, source from many, and only pay for what you actually use.

Since being founded in ****, we've acquired Virgin Mobile MEA, Friendi Mobile MEA and Virgin Mobile LATAM (with 6.5 million subscribers) and **** dedicated colleagues across Chile, Colombia, KSA, Kuwait, Mexico, Oman, Pakistan and UAE.

To disrupt for good takes a rebellious spirit, a questioning mind and a warm heart. We really care about how to get things done and not who manages who. We benefit from our diversity, and together, we disrupt the way we and others thinking about our lives for good.

Do you want to exchange ideas, learn from each other and leave your mark on our journey? This is the place for you.

Role Purpose

Why This Role Matters

As a Digital Acquisition Sr. Director, you will lead the digital growth engine for Virgin Mobile Mexico, driving customer acquisition and revenue through high-impact performance marketing strategies. This role is critical in scaling the business efficiently, ensuring every investment delivers measurable growth while strengthening our position in a highly competitive market.

What Success Looks Like

Strong and consistent subscriber growth across digital channels

Optimized CAC with clear improvements in ROI and marketing efficiency

High-performing digital funnels with improved conversion rates (web and app)

Data-driven decision-making embedded across all marketing initiatives

Seamless collaboration across local and global stakeholders

A high-performing, agile digital marketing team delivering measurable impact

Why This Is For You

This is an opportunity to own and shape the digital acquisition strategy for a fast-growing, digital-first brand. If you thrive in performance-driven environments, enjoy combining data with creativity, and want to make a tangible impact on business growth, this role offers both autonomy and visibility at a leadership level.

Key Responsibilities

In This Role, You Will Be Responsible For

Performance Marketing

Own digital acquisition strategy across paid media (Meta, Google, TikTok, programmatic)

Drive subscriber growth, CAC optimization, and ROI improvements

Manage performance budgets with strong discipline on attribution and incrementality

E-commerce & Conversion Optimization

Optimize digital sales funnels (web/app) to improve conversion rates

Partner with product and UX teams to enhance user journeys

Lead A/B testing roadmap across landing pages, checkout, and onboarding

Data & Analytics

Own marketing dashboards and reporting (CAC, LTV, ROAS, funnel metrics)

Leverage tools like Google Analytics, AppsFlyer/Adjust, CRM platforms

Translate data into actionable insights for growth

Brand & Content Alignment

Ensure performance marketing aligns with brand positioning

Collaborate with creative teams to deliver high-performing ad creatives

Maintain consistency across digital touchpoints

Cross-functional Leadership

Work closely with product, commercial, and technology teams

Manage external agencies and partners

Mentor and build a high-performing digital marketing team

Qualifications & Attributes

We're seeking someone who embodies the following:

Education

bachelor's degree in marketing, Business, Economics, or a related field (Master's degree is a plus)

Experience

8–10 years of experience in digital marketing, with strong focus on performance marketing

Proven track record of scaling digital acquisition and driving revenue growth

Experience in telecom, MVNO, e-commerce, or digital-first businesses

Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth environments

Technical Skills

Strong expertise in paid media platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, programmatic)

Hands-on experience with analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, AppsFlyer, Adjust, CRM platforms)

Deep understanding of CAC, LTV, ROAS, and funnel optimization

Familiarity with mobile app growth and attribution frameworks

Unique Attributes

Highly analytical with a strong data-driven mindset

Strategic thinker with a hands-on, execution-focused approach

Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

Ability to operate both at a strategic and tactical level

Fluency in both Spanish and English (mandatory)

Our Hiring Process

Recruiter Chat

Here's what you can expect during the interview process:

A conversation to understand your background, ambitions, and expectations.

Hiring Manager Interview

A deep dive into the role, your experience, and how you could add value to our team.

Feedback Loop

Depending on the role, you'll meet with key stakeholders across the organization to get a 360° view of the role.

Leadership Interview

For senior roles, expect a conversation with our leadership or CEO to align on vision and cultural fit.

Our Commitment to Feedback

At Beyond ONE, we are dedicated to offering clear and constructive feedback throughout the interview process. If you reach the interview stage but aren't selected, we will provide feedback to help you understand what our team appreciated in your application and where we identified gaps. We believe offering thoughtful feedback is essential for building trust and fostering long-term relationships, even with candidates we may not hire.

What We Offer

Rapid learning opportunities - we enable learning through flexible career paths, exposure to challenging & meaningful work that will help build and strengthen your expertise.

Healthcare And Other Local Benefits Offered In Market.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of Greenhouse & BrightHire during the recruitment process. This may include the storage and processing of your data on servers located outside your country of residence. For further information, please contact us at ******.

Impulsar la alineación comercial entre las áreas de B2B, Retail, Marketing, Medios, Merchandising, Finanzas y Operaciones para garantizar una experiencia omnicanal integrada y una ejecución consistente.

Representar al negocio digital de México frente a los equipos regionales (LATAM y Américas) y globales, aportando conocimiento del mercado local mientras se aseguran la correcta implementación de prioridades globales en México.

Liderar revisiones periódicas del desempeño del negocio, convirtiendo datos e insights en prioridades y planes de acción concretos, cuestionando el status quo y elevando constantemente el desempeño comercial digital.

Experiencia sólida operando dentro de modelos de negocio de distribución propia y gestionando ecosistemas complejos de comercio electrónico a nivel local.

Historial comprobado de colaboración efectiva con equipos multifuncionales de Media Performance, Merchandising, Planeación de Demanda y Abasto (Demand & Supply Planning), Compras (Buying), Marketing, B2B y Retail.
Capacidad demostrada para desenvolverse exitosamente en entornos dinámicos y colaborar de manera efectiva con equipos regionales (LATAM y Américas) y stakeholders globales.
Dominio fluido de español e inglés, tanto oral como escrito.

Fuerte visión comercial, respaldada por sólidas capacidades analíticas en métricas de e-commerce, proyecciones financieras (forecasting) y optimización de la experiencia y recorrido del cliente (customer journey).

description:
Company Description Pravaah Consulting is an AI and product engineering firm serving mid-market and growth-stage companies, headquartered in Dublin, California, with distributed engineering teams worldwide. Over the past seven years, the company has delivered more than 300 projects for over 250 clients, focusing on complex operations and underused data in manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, and retail. Pravaah uses structured approaches like its FORGE roadmap to prioritize AI initiatives and seamlessly align with existing ERP and IT partners. Its work spans agentic AI systems, predictive ML, computer vision, custom software, vertical SaaS, and digital commerce solutions. As a Google Cloud and Databricks partner, Pravaah helps organizations turn scattered AI ideas into scalable, production-ready products.

Role Description The Sales and Marketing Specialist is a full-time, hybrid role based in the Mexico City Metropolitan Area, with flexibility for some work from home. This role is responsible for identifying and qualifying prospects, nurturing leads, and supporting the full sales cycle for Pravaah’s AI and product engineering offerings. The specialist will execute marketing campaigns across digital channels, develop sales collateral and presentations, and coordinate webinars, events, and outreach activities. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing CRM entries, preparing proposals, tracking pipeline metrics, and collaborating with technical and delivery teams to align messaging with project capabilities. The role also involves engaging with existing clients to support upsell and cross-sell opportunities, gathering market feedback, and contributing to demand-generation and brand awareness initiatives in the region.

Connect clients with Storm's wider expertise so they experience the depth and connected value of the team.

Commercial awareness and the ability to recognize scope pressure, service gaps, account risk, and useful growth opportunities.

Comfort with collaborative systems such as Airtable, Monday.com, Notion, Asana, spreadsheets, Slack, Teams, or similar tools, plus an appetite to improve them.
Clear written and spoken communication. You make messy situations feel calm and practical and work well asynchronously.
Attention to detail held at speed: names, dates, decisions, dependencies, status, and promises stay accurate.
Enthusiasm for how quickly AI-enabled knowledge work is evolving, with an instinct for what improves client work and what is just noise.

Meet with Account Management leadership or our recruitment team.

Meet with a senior leader for a second interview and discussion of your approach.

Embracing Future-Facing Technology 




Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. As the world adapts, we’re committed to safely exploring the potential advantages of AI, integrating it thoughtfully into our work where possible, and one day guiding our clients through new possibilities when they’re open and ready for them. We are hiring an Account Manager to grow client confidence, satisfaction, and account value. title: Short-Form Video Editor (Social Ads & Reels)
description:
IMPORTANT: We're only selecting candidates who have a portfolio link in their resume.




Description:

Picture a wellness brand that isn't about restriction or perfection — it's about living fully and bouncing back fast. This fast-growing, science-backed supplement brand helps people recover, hydrate, and sleep better so they can keep showing up for the moments that matter, whether that's a big night out, an early flight, or just a demanding week. Trusted by hundreds of thousands of customers and featured across major media, this brand has built a loyal, energetic community — and now they need a Video Editor who can turn raw footage, UGC, and creative concepts into scroll-stopping content that fuels their next stage of growth. This is a hands-on role for someone who lives and breathes short-form video, understands what makes people stop scrolling, and wants their editing to directly move the needle on a brand people already love. 




What You’ll Do:

→ Cut for Impact: Edit fast-paced, on-trend short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts that grab attention in the first second.

→ Shape the Story: Turn raw UGC, influencer content, and in-house footage into polished, on-brand videos with strong pacing and narrative flow.

→ Stay Ahead of Trends: Keep a pulse on platform trends, sounds, and formats, and translate them into fresh content ideas before they go stale.

→ Collaborate Closely: Work hand-in-hand with the creative and marketing team to bring campaign concepts to life, from rough brief to finished cut.

→ Optimize for Performance: Use data and performance insights to refine editing choices, hooks, and pacing that actually convert.

→ Manage the Pipeline: Juggle multiple projects and deadlines, keeping content flowing consistently without sacrificing quality.

→ Proven Editor: 2+ years of experience editing short-form video content, ideally for a DTC, lifestyle, or consumer brand.

→ Tool Fluent: Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, with a sharp eye for pacing, sound design, and motion graphics.

title: Performance Creative Editor (Contract)
skills: Cut paid ads for Meta and Google from scripts and angles handed to you by a strategist. Vertical, sound-on, short, fast-paced

Own the hook. The script arrives written; the first five seconds are your call. We have firm views, built from our own account data, about which openers work for this product and which quietly kill a good ad. You will learn them in week one, apply them without being asked, and argue when one is wrong
Iterate winners, not only originate. Most of your month is making something that already works work harder, which in our testing beats originating from scratch by a wide margin
Build variants that change one thing on purpose. We have burned whole quarters on same-day copies that duplicated instead of testing. A variant that teaches us nothing is worse than no variant

Read your own numbers. You get access to our creative analytics and attribution tools, and your output is measured. You bring reads to the weekly creative review rather than waiting to be told what lost
Paid ads as the spine of your work. You can name a brand that spent money distributing something you cut
A performance number you personally moved on a specific piece of creative, before and after

You know which metrics decide and which mislead. An ad is judged on spend and acquisition cost over its first week, not on thumbstop or hold rate. Plenty of good editors optimise for retention and engagement because those are the numbers they are shown. We will ask you which metrics you have actually been held to and what you think they do and do not predict. There is a right answer and it is not the obvious one

AI creation, fluently and invisibly. Generative tooling is how you hit variant volume at this cadence: image and video generation, voice, upscaling, automated captioning and reframing. The bar is output nobody can tell was generated. We are not buying AI-looking content, we are buying your speed
Premiere or DaVinci to a professional standard, plus After Effects or CapCut. You finish your own sound
English good enough to argue with a media buyer about why a hook is wrong
Your own machine, reliable internet, a quiet place to take a call
Supplements, wellness, beverage, beauty or DTC subscription. Our claims language is regulated
Range across the formats direct response actually runs on: offer-led creative, objection and confession openers, and one person talking to camera. Tell us which you are strongest in
Creative analytics tooling such as Motion, Triple Whale or Northbeam
Cutting from creator and UGC footage, including the unglamorous work of making mediocre raw material perform
description:
We sell mushroom coffee direct to consumers. Paid ads on Meta and Google are how we grow, and the creative is the variable that decides whether it works. We test continuously and we measure what wins, so the feedback you get here is specific rather than taste-based.

Our creative strategists write the scripts and own the angle. You own the execution and, specifically, the first five seconds. You will ship 15 to 25 finished ads a month, deliberately fewer than most performance shops expect, because we would rather you spend the hours deciding what to change than cutting another variant nobody learns from.

Not required: a degree, a cinematic showreel, agency names on your resume, or managing anyone.

Before you apply

We decline a lot of genuinely skilled editors who have never cut a direct-response ad. That wastes everyone's time, so, plainly:

Not a fit if your portfolio is mainly corporate or internal communications, brand films, weddings and events, news or broadcast, documentary, event recaps and sizzle reels, music videos, real estate, podcast production, long-form YouTube, or B2B training. Those are real crafts and close to the opposite problem: a beautiful 90-second brand film and an ad that holds a stranger for three seconds and sells coffee are not the same skill.

The test: can you name a brand that paid to distribute something you cut, and the metric you were judged on? If the honest answer is that you have made great videos but nobody bought media against them, this seat will not work, and we would rather say so now than after two interviews.

One more thing. A cover letter that repeats this posting back to us reads exactly as it sounds. Tell us about your work instead.

Benefits

Engagement

Independent contractor, ongoing, invoiced monthly. Not employment.

Location

Remote, anywhere in Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, or Uruguay. You are responsible for your own taxes and any local registration.

Hours

Async by default. We ask for 2-3 hours of daily overlap with Austin, Texas (Central Time) for the creative review and buyer conversations. You choose which hours.

Commitment

Full-time equivalent effort. We are not looking for someone fitting this between three other clients.

Equipment

Yours. We provide software seats (Adobe CC, Motion, Frame.io) and all footage, product and creator assets.

Start

As soon as the right person is found.

skills: Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working

Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people

Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing

Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule
Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery

Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why
Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team
Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt

You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search
You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have

You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it

You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list
You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard
You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you
Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too

You need a ticketing system to know what matters

description:

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

You want to be told what to do this week
You need a ticketing system to know what matters
You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question


Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Requirements

What the job looks like


Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule
Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery
Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why
Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team
Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt


You are a fit if


You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search
You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have
You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it
You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list
You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard
You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you
Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too


You are not a fit if


"That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed
You want to be told what to do this week
You need a ticketing system to know what matters
You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question


Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Senior Specialist, TV, Video, Audio & Display (TVAD), you will launch and improve TV, video, audio, and display campaigns to grow new customers and revenue - while keeping efficiency on track. You’ll follow clear Tinuiti Way practices, turn performance and media learnings into next actions, and pilot small, safe innovations before wider rollout. You’ll partner closely with Client Leadership, Analytics/Econometrics, Creative, and channel teams (Search, Social, Commerce/Retail Media) in your Pod, communicate clearly with clients, and document what works so the team can reuse it. We align scope and expectations to our job architecture for consistency and transparent progression.

We’re looking for experienced marketing leaders in roles such as Head of Marketing, VP of Marketing, Marketing Director, Growth Marketing Leader, or CMO who have built B2B marketing functions, led marketing teams, and owned end-to-end marketing strategy and execution, with a strong focus on search (SEO and AEO/GEO) and demand generation.




Remote (LATAM) · Reports to our Co-CEO




About Viva Talent

Viva Talent connects US companies with Executive Assistants and Recruiting Coordinators and opens meaningful, career-defining work for talented people across Latin America and South Africa. We're a globally distributed team of 240+ people across 16+ countries and 3 continents, on a mission to expand real opportunity for women in LatAm.




Why this role exists

Viva’s gearing up for its next growth phase. We need you to build our marketing function from the ground up and improve/accelerate the sustainable pipeline of qualified buyers that drives more revenue.

This is a build-and-lead seat: you’ll set the strategy, get it moving yourself, then hire and coach the team that runs it. If getting into the weeds makes you excited, this is your seat. If being a player-coach does not excite you, or being the player until you hire the team to coach, this is not the role for you.




What you’ll do

Two numbers you'll be measured on: Inbound calls booked and Inbound closed-won deals.

Define and lead marketing strategy. Decide where we place our next bets and where we don’t: focus, channel mix, budget allocation, quarterly rocks. ← This is the 1st problem you'll own.
Execute the strategy. Once you build the plan and identify the processes, tools, and support needed, make it happen and use results to decide what to improve next. ← This is the 2nd problem you’ll own.
Build the team. Hire, develop, and coach the team you need to deliver results (e.g., SEO, content, design, link building, etc), and vendors where/if it makes sense.
Connect marketing to business outcomes. Plan OKRs with leadership, define success metrics, and track progress so everyone has a clear view of what it will take to see results.
Own our narrative. Shape Viva’s story, messaging, and positioning so the right buyers understand why Viva, why our services, and why now.
Drive cross-functional alignment. Work with both Co-CEOs and leaders across Sales, Customer Success, People, and RevOps to keep priorities aligned, keep HubSpot lead reporting accurate, and diagnose funnel issues together.




Who you are

You’re a hands-on marketing leader who has already solved this challenge elsewhere.

5+ years managing & leading marketing teams end to end, from defining the strategy to driving execution and results.
You’ve owned SEO end to end and scaled it from 1 to N, and have worked with AEO/GEO. You’ve also built other channels such as events or paid ads from 0 to 1.
You’ve hired, coached, and developed marketing teams, and managed external vendors and agencies.
You’ve generated qualified pipeline for B2B companies with $100K+ ACV.
You’ve marketed to US executive buyers, ideally C-suite, VP, or Head-level, at tech companies from scale-ups to enterprise.
Executive-level English (C1+). You keep up in fast-paced conversations with executives, clearly explain your decisions and the reasoning behind them, and negotiate trade-offs and how plans move forward.




Why you’ll want this

This is a rare seat where you build the function instead of inheriting it. You'll own the number, the playbook, and the team, with a direct line to the founders and real autonomy over how Viva grows.

The work you’ll do will be pivotal to Viva’s growth, revenue, and team and will directly impact how we reach our mission of creating 1,000 meaningful career opportunities across Latin America.




Benefits

We invest heavily in our people through:

100% remote work, forever.
Competitive compensation with reviews every six months and performance bonuses.
Comprehensive global health insurance, including medical, dental, vision, mental health, and routine care.
Paid holidays, vacation, sick leave, and family care days.
Family-friendly policies, including parental leave and flexible support.
A culture centered around growth, ownership, well-being, and continuous learning.

With a 4.7/5 Glassdoor rating, we're proud of the experience we create for both our candidates and our team.




How we hire

A focused process: application → initial interview → a practical skills assessment → assessment debrief → final interview

description:
TITLE: Marketing Analyst, Global G2M Enablement & Design

LOCATION:  Mexico (ECoE)

REPORTS TO: Global G2M Enablement Manager

Company Background

Ingredion is a global Fortune 500 provider of ingredient solutions that touch millions of lives, every day. With over 19,000 customers in 120 countries, we create solutions that help nourish, comfort, and delight people all over the world. We are proud to source our strength from nature. That’s why we’re growing sustainably, with an industry-leading product portfolio that includes plant-based proteins, sugar alternatives and clean and simple ingredients that deliver on changing consumer needs while protecting our planet. Although we are best known for our food ingredients, we are much more than a food business. We co-create bespoke solutions with our customers; from cosmetics and beauty, to paper and textiles, to pharmaceuticals, driven by relentless curiosity. We make it our business to anticipate industry trends, and to bring together the potential of people, nature and technology to make life better.

We don’t just make ingredients. We create possibilities. Be What’s Next® with us.

The Marketing Analyst, Global G2M Enablement & Design will support the G2M Enablement function and provide the “go to-market” (G2M) teams with information (as in data to evaluate trends, messaging, targeting and qualification criteria), content (such as sales guides and one-pagers) and tools (like ROI calculators and solution configurators) needed to help them sell more effectively. In addition, this person will have expertise in content design to leverage the right tools/technology in creating branded assets for the G2M teams. In essence, it involves providing the sales and broader G2M team what they need to successfully engage a buyer and / or technical counterpart throughout the buyer journey. This role will be critical in translating key data, insights and messaging into materials and assets to engage customers. The person in this position will act as an integrator between marketing, sales and technical to “make buying easy.” In addition, this role will develop and drive G2M Enablement best practices across the organization.

Working in close collaboration with the Marketing Communication / Branding and Digital Communication Centers of Excellence plus Global Category Leads and regional commercial / marketing teams, this global position will develop the sales enablement tools and training needed to be successful in the market.

As a Marketing Analyst, Your Responsibilities Will Include


Support the development and embed an updated strategy for global product launches and Go-to-Market initiatives to align with the new strategy and annual Marketing Plan
Translate Global Marketing Plan and activation to regional G2M execution plans: Clarify the value propositions, the story and messaging of our product/solutions offeringClarify the value propositions, the story and messaging of key capabilities available to customersDevelop cross-portfolio/category positioning as well as collateral and tools to help sellers and the G2M team win with customers
Expertise and leadership in content design to leverage the right tools/technology in creating high-end, branded assets for the G2M teams
Standardize content management and delivery practices throughout the sales cycle
Ensure content is kept up to date, on brand and stored in an easy-to-use & accessible repository and the latest version is disseminated to the G2M teams in an efficient way

Assess company’s sales processes to understand and enhance the skills, knowledge, and tools required for the sales force (and G2M team) to increase velocity and conversion rates at each stage in those processes
Utilize and leverage digital technology tools for disseminating, reporting and benchmarking

Understand the language of sales, sales data & process, and how Marketing can add value

Job Description

As we transform into the autonomous enterprise, we are proactively engaging with talent who will play a key role in building the capabilities required to deliver on our 2027 priorities

Candidates can be based anywhere in LAC region.

If you understand AI well enough to explain it in a customer meeting, and you get just as excited about solving a business problem as a technical one, these roles were written for you. Customers come to SAP with specific problems, a timeline, and a board asking questions. Your job is to understand what they're actually facing, work out what AI can genuinely do for them, and help them get there. With 400,000 customers across every industry, the scale and variety of what you'll be working on is unlike most roles in tech right now.

What You'll Bring

You independently engage customers throughout the sales cycle, delivering compelling demonstrations and solution stories that differentiate SAP. You combine strong commercial awareness with an AI-native advisory approach — bringing creativity and the genuine ability to make technology tangible for any customer, across any industry and any solution domain.


Skilled at conducting thorough client needs assessments across varied industries and solution areas, translating complex customer requirements into tailored solution positioning built on business insight
Strong command of AI value selling, positioning SAP's AI capabilities confidently and shaping how customers approach their AI investment decisions across their organisation
Skilled in system-integrated vibe coding — applying AI-assisted development approaches within SAP's technology ecosystem to prototype and customise demonstration environments rapidly, driven by creativity and commercial instinct
Demonstrated use of rapid field prototyping to build, iterate, and deliver high-impact demo content quickly across SAP's full solution portfolio in response to specific customer needs
Skilled at developing and delivering customer value propositions that align SAP solution capabilities to measurable business outcomes across any industry or customer context
Degree not required for this role.


We also look for people who build trust naturally, communicate with clarity, keep the customer at the centre of what they do, and bring emotional intelligence and genuine problem-solving ability to the challenges they face.

In addition to the skills and experience specific to this role, all positions at SAP require candidates who are comfortable using AI tools — including agentic AI — in their day-to-day work, from crafting effective inputs and automating routine tasks, to evaluating AI-generated outputs for quality and driving adoption of AI practices within their teams.

What You'll Build

You will independently engage customers at critical points in the sales cycle — developing and delivering differentiated demonstrations, co-creating the SAP vision with customers and partners, and building adoption and revenue outcomes across SAP's full solution portfolio.


Independently engage customers throughout the sales cycle, developing and delivering compelling stories and demonstrations across any SAP solution domain that illustrate differentiated business outcomes

Apply rapid field prototyping to build and iterate high-impact demo content at pace, tailored to specific customer contexts across SAP's full portfolio
Build and deliver customer value propositions that position SAP solutions at the centre of measurable business outcomes for any customer, in any industry


Where you belong

You will be part of the Customer Value Group, a global solution advisory community that values customer engagement, solution expertise, and revenue growth through trusted relationships. At this level you operate with real independence — engaging customers with authority across SAP's full solution portfolio, building trusted relationships, and delivering advisory outcomes that influence purchase decisions. It is an environment for someone who thrives on variety, takes genuine pride in the quality and impact of their work, and brings the same energy and rigour to every customer regardless of industry or domain.

Analizar información comercial como sell-in, sell-out, pricing, mix y promociones para identificar variaciones, explicar sus causas y generar recomendaciones tácticas para el negocio.
Convertir datos y reportes en visualizaciones e historias claras que respondan al “¿qué significa esto para el negocio?” y faciliten la toma de decisiones.

Licenciatura concluida en Ingeniería, Economía, Actuaría, Sistemas, Administración o una carrera afín.
Mínimo 2 años de experiencia; idealmente entre 2 y 3 años en Business Intelligence, análisis de datos, análisis comercial o funciones relacionadas.
Experiencia práctica en la creación y mantenimiento de tableros en Microsoft Power BI.
Conocimientos de DAX de nivel básico a intermedio.
Manejo avanzado de Excel, incluyendo tablas dinámicas y Power Query.
Conocimientos básicos de SQL para consultar, filtrar y unir tablas mediante joins.
Comprensión de bases de datos relacionales, calidad de datos y validación contra fuentes originales.
Capacidad para analizar datos comerciales y convertirlos en conclusiones y recomendaciones para el negocio.
Comunicación clara en español y capacidad para presentar información a públicos técnicos y no técnicos.
Pensamiento analítico, orientación a resultados, curiosidad, organización y capacidad para colaborar con diferentes áreas.

¿Por qué Hershey?

En The Hershey Company, creemos que las empresas pueden crear oportunidades y generar un impacto positivo en la vida de las personas. Esta visión, inspirada por nuestro fundador, Milton Hershey, continúa dando forma a nuestra cultura y a la manera en que contribuimos a las comunidades donde vivimos, trabajamos y hacemos negocios.

Somos una empresa líder en la industria de snacks, con un portafolio de marcas icónicas como Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers y muchas más. Nuestro propósito va más allá de nuestros productos: apoyamos a las comunidades y ayudamos a que niños y jóvenes prosperen a través de iniciativas de responsabilidad social, donaciones, voluntariado y nuestra colaboración de largo plazo con Milton Hershey School, invirtiendo en educación y preparación para el mundo laboral.

Guiados por nuestra propuesta de valor, “Lidera hoy. Crea el mañana.”, y nuestra mentalidad One Hershey, conectamos personas, funciones, geografías y negocios para trabajar con agilidad, colaboración y un propósito compartido. Modern Tools & A Real AI Stack

Ideas Welcome, Always

description:
The Lead, AI Business Enablement guides the artificial intelligence journey of Newell's LATAM eCommerce business. It is a senior individual contributor role for a curious builder: someone who turns AI capability into commercial results across Amazon, Mercado Libre and other strategic digital customers, and who helps the whole regional organization work smarter along the way.

You'll have real freedom to explore, prototype and test ideas — and the backing to scale the ones that succeed. Some experiments won't work, and that's part of the deal. What matters is learning fast, being honest about results and turning the wins into everyday practice across the region.




Where You'll Make an Impact

Your energy will center on three missions.

Mission 1 | Drive Commercial Growth

Build the insight-to-action engine that accelerates revenue and profitability across Amazon, Mercado Libre and other strategic digital customers.

What you'll do

Shape the commercial analytics agenda for the region: sales, market share, pricing, digital shelf, assortment, search performance, retail media, traffic, conversion, availability, Buy Box and profitability.
Turn ambiguous business questions into quantified opportunities, business cases and executive-ready recommendations.
Partner with Sales, Category Management, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance and Digital to help decisions move from weeks to days.
Bring data to commercial priorities and help teams learn from what the numbers say.

Success looks like

Commercial decisions become faster, better informed and easier to trace to outcomes, with revenue and margin wins the team can celebrate together.

Mission 2 | Evolve Ways of Working

Champion continuous improvement across the LATAM eCommerce organization: simpler processes, less manual work and good ideas that travel across markets.

What you'll do

Explore and rethink core commercial processes together with the teams that run them.
Reduce manual work through automation and help the best practices spread across markets.
Guide cross-functional improvement initiatives from diagnosis to adoption, with empathy for how people experience change.
Create playbooks and documentation that help improvements stick.

Success looks like

A more productive organization: hours returned to commercial teams, fewer handoffs and ways of working that scale naturally across countries.

Mission 3 | Explore, Test and Scale AI

Take AI from ideas to everyday practice through experimentation: try, test, learn and scale what works.

What you'll do

Spot and prioritize promising AI use cases across the business, guided by a clear view of potential value.
Prototype, pilot and scale solutions such as commercial copilots, AI agents, workflow automation, pricing and competitive intelligence, content generation, reporting automation and knowledge assistants.
Care for quality along the way: evaluation, reliability, responsible AI practices and data privacy, including LGPD.
Nurture adoption through enablement, training and honest measurement of real usage.
Stay curious about the frontier and test emerging AI technologies.

Success looks like

AI woven into everyday operations, with adoption and impact everyone can see: less manual work, faster execution and a growing competitive edge.

How You'll Operate

As a P3 in Newell's Job Architecture, you'll work with a high degree of autonomy under broad direction.

Shape: the LATAM eCommerce AI enablement roadmap, solution design and prioritization, and regional best practices.
Influence: cross-functional, multi-country initiatives, partnering with stakeholders up to Director level.
Develop others: mentor analysts across the region and help grow the organization's AI fluency.
Recommend: bring investment ideas, vendor options and trade-offs to eCommerce leadership with a clear point of view.

Your First Year: Explore, Experiment, Scale

A natural arc for the first 12 months, which we'll shape together.

Explore — first 90 days: immerse in the business, listen to teams across markets, map workflows and identify the opportunities with the most potential.
Experiment — by month six: launch the first pilots in one or two markets, test and learn, and measure openly what works and what doesn't.
Scale — by month 12: turn the successful experiments into solutions adopted across the region, and share the learning openly, including from the pilots that didn't make it.

What You'll Bring




Experience And Skills

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Business or a related quantitative field; an advanced degree (MBA or MS) is a plus.
Around seven years or more of experience across eCommerce, commercial analytics, digital transformation or AI solutions, including meaningful hands-on time designing, testing and deploying AI or automation solutions that made it into everyday use.
Stories of things you've built: solutions people actually adopted, the results they produced and the experiments that taught you the most.
Strong marketplace fluency: the economics of Amazon and Mercado Libre, including retail media, digital shelf, search, Buy Box dynamics, 1P/3P models and profitability drivers.
Hands-on comfort with SQL and Python, plus working command of LLM APIs and frameworks (prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, evaluation), enterprise automation (Power Platform, n8n, Make) and advanced Power BI.
Confident, clear communication with senior stakeholders, in writing and in the room.

Guiados por nuestros valores fundamentales de integridad, excelencia, responsabilidad y trabajo en equipo, fomentamos un ambiente de trabajo seguro, incluyente y gratificante, donde un equipo talentoso y experimentado trabaja en conjunto para ofrecer operaciones confiables, minería responsable y valor a largo plazo para nuestros accionistas y las comunidades donde operamos.

description:
About Us

Most AI is frozen in place - it doesn’t adapt to the world. We think that’s backwards. Our mandate is to build efficient intelligence that evolves in real-time. We bring together exceptional people with the drive and creativity to push the boundaries of continual adaptation. We’re looking for builders and creative thinkers ready to shape the next era of intelligence.

Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in accountability, initiative and shared success. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. We operate with low egos, high velocity, and extreme ownership to build technology that expands access and benefits the many, not the few.

How We Work


Impact over activity: We are building a generational company. We value people who execute on ideas rather than comment from the sidelines. We believe our competitive edge lies in caring about excellence across the entire lifecycle - from research to product. No task is beneath anyone: no one is too senior to test the build, clean the data, or unblock a teammate. 
Vulnerable, low-ego collaboration: We believe exceptional work comes from people who challenge, support and push one another to think bigger. Rapid iteration requires stepping into discomfort. We encourage bold, half-baked, and unorthodox ideas. When we disagree, we share feedback directly, never through side channels. 
Celebrate decisively: Extraordinary effort should be deeply memorable. We celebrate milestones generously and publicly - via spot bonuses, team dinners, spontaneous gifts, and company-wide recognition - to fuel each other for the next sprint. 


The Role

Our vision is AI systems that are flexible, adaptable, and accessible to everyone. We believe efficiency is what makes this possible. It’s how we expand access and ensure innovation benefits the many, not the few.

Part of that commitment is to engage with a wider ecosystem of early adopters, researchers and developers, and make sure we engage deeply with our mission of building progress at the edge of what is possible.

You authentically care about our mission of empowering builders globally to have more control over AI. Your core strength is bringing people together. You craft and organize experiences that allow users to connect with Adaption, our team, and with each other.

What You'll Do


Establish our overall strategy for supporting developers, researchers and enterprises who want to have more control over their AI. 
Build and maintain Adaption's developer community spaces (Discord server, forums) from the ground up, answer questions, capture feedback, and turn it into actionable issues for the team
Develop, manage, and run Adaption's ambassador program, from recruiting and onboarding ambassadors to equipping them with the resources, recognition, and support to represent Adaption in their own communities. 
Organize and lead meetups, hackathons, office hours, and live streams that introduce Adaption to new developer audiences
Collaborate with developer groups, universities, accelerators, and open-source communities to co-host and amplify high-quality events
Spotlight user projects and design partners (case studies, writeups, guest talks). 
Build automations and systems that make community operations scale - when you do something twice, you figure out how to do it better the third time
Work closely with technical and marketing teams on cross-functional projects and feedback loops
Stay connected with community members over time, keeping a mental map of who's doing interesting work, who should meet who, and what people are building


Skills You'll Bring

We look beyond traditional markers of experience. What matters most to us is what you’ve built and the impact you’ve had. We value demonstrable output, curiosity and alignment with our core values:


2–3 years in a community lead role or start up ops role, with a track record of engaging technical users
Strong operations instincts - you've built scalable processes from scratch and driven cross-functional initiatives to completion
Strong written communication and experience engaging with communities over socials (Discord, X)
Proven experience organizing developer events end-to-end, from small meetups to large-scale hackathons
Genuine empathy for developers and curiosity about what they're building - you care about individuals, and about changing the status quo of who can shape AI. Energized by people - social situations charge you up, you're the first to say hello, and you follow up


Above all, we're looking for great teammates who make work feel lighter and aren't afraid to go out on a limb with bold ideas. You don't need to be perfect, but you do need to be adaptable. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check every box.

title: AI-First Copy & Community Manager
skills: Write engaging, on-brand social copy for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, YouTube and other relevant platforms, with AI tools and agentic workflows as your default way of working.
Review and refine social copy for clarity, accuracy and audience fit, adapting each piece to its platform and purpose.

Learn each brand's voice, audience and subject matter deeply enough to judge when AI output fits. Maintain and evolve tone-of-voice guidance, source context and examples that people and agents can use consistently.

Fact-check against supplied sources and proofread everything you deliver, including anything AI touched. Check names, claims, grammar, punctuation, links, accessibility and platform-native formatting; treat rights and brand safety as fixed points.

Pitch social content angles and approaches that improve engagement and visibility. Apply copywriting best practice, using performance signals and feedback to improve attention, reach and the quality of the writing.

Engage communities day to day: respond to comments and join relevant conversations on fan, talent and partner content. Keep replies timely, appropriate and consistent with the brand's personality and engagement approach.

Stay close to culture, fandom, trends and platform developments. Surface timely engagement opportunities that suit the audience, and feed what you learn from conversations back into copy and content ideas.

Use agents for repeatable work such as preparing copy variants, checking against source material and summarising community themes. Review their work critically, make the editorial decisions and keep useful records for clear handovers.
Prioritise deadlines and responsive community work, balance a shared workload with colleagues across time zones, and adapt constructively to feedback and changing priorities.

Keep improving how the work gets done: encode your best methods into reusable skills and workflows that agents and teammates can pick up and run, and teach what works so the whole team levels up with you. Test new capabilities against real briefs, compare the results with your current approach, and update shared methods when they improve quality or reliability.
Excellent written English and a strong editorial ear. Your writing shows precision, range, personality and an ability to adapt tone without losing clarity.
Community judgment: you understand fan behaviour, can write a natural response and recognise when to engage, pause or escalate. You bring a real interest in TV, film and online culture.

Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI agents in work, study or personal projects. You can show how you build context, direct production and checks, reject weak output and improve the result. You have examples beyond asking a chatbot for ideas.

Confidence working with editorial documents, social platforms and AI tools. You may bring a traditional copy background with a developed AI practice, or have built your craft using AI from the start. Either path works here.
Sound fact-checking and accessibility knowledge, with the attention to detail to hold the quality bar at speed. You can explain the choices behind your copy and replies.
A systems mindset and ownership: you spot repeatable work, improve it and follow through. You can demonstrate a reusable method and explain how you help someone else use it successfully.
Clear communication, reliable organisation and thoughtful asynchronous handovers. You share work well, respond to feedback and learn new tools with an eye for what improves the result.

💸 USD 24,000 - USD 28,000 per year, on a full-time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote working!

✨ Create sharp copy and meaningful community conversations for globally recognised brands in US TV and entertainment.

🔍 Work with AI agents, reusable skills and editorial context libraries at the centre of your craft.

💻 High-end, fast computer

💡 All the latest software and productivity tools you’ll need




About the Role 




You write copy that sounds right for the brand and gives people a reason to care. You also know how to join a fan conversation: when a thoughtful reply adds something, when humour fits, and when an issue needs escalating. This is a hands-on role owning the relationship between a brand and its community through strong copy and thoughtful engagement.




Storm is an AI-native agency. AI tools and agentic workflows are central to how our teams work, and we hire people who want to work that way from day one.




AI-first doesn't mean AI-generated. The work itself is craft: finding the right angle, shaping a line and responding with judgment. You direct agents through Codex, using reusable skills and context libraries of brand voice, source material and editorial examples to produce copy variants, edit working documents and run structured checks. You catch the bland line, unsupported claim or reply that misses the mood, and make it better. Your editorial judgment stays in charge of every word.




You'll learn the ground first: what we make and the bar it has to hit. Social copy that earns attention. Community replies that make the brand feel like part of the fandom. Then you'll work from Storm's stack of AI and creative tools, and play a real part in improving how this work gets done.




About Storm Ideas 




Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.

Storm brings together entertainment, fandom, creative production, community and technology.




We help major brands build stronger relationships with their audiences, while using AI to improve how that work is created, checked and delivered.




We are a remote-first, fast-moving company with established clients, a growing team, and a strong appetite for better tools, better systems, and better ways of working. AI is central to how we operate — every team, every role, this one included.




What You Will Do

Write engaging, on-brand social copy for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, YouTube and other relevant platforms, with AI tools and agentic workflows as your default way of working.
Review and refine social copy for clarity, accuracy and audience fit, adapting each piece to its platform and purpose.

Test new capabilities against real briefs, compare the results with your current approach, and update shared methods when they improve quality or reliability.




Success means distinctive, accurate copy; timely community responses that fit the conversation; and improvements that reduce avoidable revisions and help teammates deliver consistently. You can show what your methods changed, using examples, feedback and useful measures.




What We Are Looking For

Excellent written English and a strong editorial ear. Your writing shows precision, range, personality and an ability to adapt tone without losing clarity.

Clear communication, reliable organisation and thoughtful asynchronous handovers. You share work well, respond to feedback and learn new tools with an eye for what improves the result.




What It's Like To Work Here




Modern Tech Stack

You’ll work with a supported AI stack, shared context and reusable skills, backed by our AI Operations team. You’ll build on established tools and methods, contribute improvements, and help colleagues put them into practice.




Your Methods Can Become How The Team Works 

We actively encourage people to bring forward better ways of working. When a method you develop proves itself, you won't just use it quietly: you'll encode it as a skill others can run, teach it to the team, and watch it become the new standard, with your name on it.




Team-based

Join an international, remote-first team of 175+ people who value skill, initiative and collaboration. You work closely with copy and account colleagues and contribute to a shared quality bar.




Flexibility

Fully remote-first. You will work 37.5 hours per week within a 9am–5:30pm Pacific Time schedule, Monday–Friday, collaborating with colleagues across time zones.




Recruitment Process




Apply with your CV, a short note explaining your fit for the role, and writing samples or a portfolio. Samples are required; personal projects count. Social copy and community-response examples are especially useful.




Shortlisted applicants complete self-recorded video questions and a short, time-boxed copy and community practical task as one screening stage.




If successful, you'll meet Tania Pardisi, Senior Copy Manager, and Nicola Taghizadeh, Chief Creative Officer, together for an interview. We'll discuss your work, your approach to community relationships and your experience using AI, and answer your questions about the role and team.




Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway if this sounds like how you already work. We are more interested in your operational judgement, reliability, follow-through, and ability to use modern tools well than in a perfect traditional CV.

Football is loved by billions, yet many still struggle to play regularly. Stranger Soccer makes playing football as easy and convenient as going for a jog or visiting the gym.

Our app lets players discover nearby games, book a spot, and simply turn up to play.

Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer now operates across 10+ cities and has delivered over 100,000 games worldwide. We're looking for passionate License Owners who want to bring this experience to their communities—whether you call it Fussball, Fútbol, Calcio, or football.

Our Mission

To make playing football as easy as going for a jog.

A world where playing football is as popular and accessible as watching football.

Ready to be part of the journey?

We'd love to hear from you.
